name: Certificate Viewer
description: Inspect X.509 certificates and chains, and check the TLS certificate a server presents
help: Paste one or more PEM certificates, or open a .pem / .crt / .cer / .der file, to see subject, issuer, validity, alternative names, key, usages and fingerprints.
The server mode connects to a host and shows the chain it actually sends, verified against your operating system's trust store, including the TLS version and cipher suite.
Expired, untrusted or mismatched certificates are still shown so you can find out what is wrong.
Only direct TLS ports such as 443, 465, 993 or 8443 are supported; STARTTLS (for example SMTP on 587) is not.
